prompt: Objective: help a meal-kit company double revenue. What you've learned: the customer count is flat because new sign-ups equal cancellations. Latest finding: half of new customers cancel within two months. What is the best next step?

options.text: Find out why new customers cancel so quickly
options.feedback: Right. Churn offsets every new customer, so understanding early cancellations comes before spending more on acquisition.
